description: Assert the active window's URL (location.href) satisfies a predicate, polling until it does or timeoutMs elapses. Provide exactly one of: contains (substring) or matches (JavaScript regex). Optional flags (any of i, m, s, u) apply to matches; g and y are rejected as stateful. Returns: { ok, session_id, matched, actual }. Errors: EXPECTATION_FAILED (URL did not match within timeoutMs — details carry expected + actual; retryable), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT (no/both predicates, or invalid regex or flags).

contains.description: The URL must contain this substring.

flags.description: Optional regex flags (any of i, m, s, u) applied to the regex predicate; g and y are rejected as stateful. Only valid alongside a regex predicate.

matches.description: The URL must match this JavaScript regular expression.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

timeoutMs.description: Max poll time in ms before EXPECTATION_FAILED (default 5000, clamped to 60000). 0 = check once.

name: electron_expect_url
title: Expect the window URL
